spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  reset
 - input  in
 - output out

Implement the following Moore state machine with two states, one input,
and one output. The reset state is B and reset is active-high
synchronous.

  B (out=1) --in=0--> A
  B (out=1) --in=1--> B
  A (out=0) --in=0--> B
  A (out=0) --in=1--> A

You can also write your own self-checking testbench (write_testbench) and run it (run_simulation). Hidden tests will grade the design; you cannot see them, so verify the behaviour yourself. You may call write_design at most 5 times. When you are confident the design is correct, call submit.
